main.intro: Product-oriented Frontend Engineer with 3+ years building scalable, user-centric web apps across cybersecurity and SaaS. I blend engineering, UX/UI design, and product thinking to own features end-to-end — from discovery to delivery.
main.headline: Hi, I'm Matías Rodríguez.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: Hi! I'm Matías. I like problems that sit between disciplines — where a cleaner interface, better code, and a sharper product decision turn out to be the same decision.
about.description2: Right now I own the end-to-end frontend of a cybersecurity SaaS platform at Metabase Q — from defining the UX in Figma to shipping accessible, high-performance interfaces in React.
about.description3: The path is the interesting part: I started as an Industrial Designer and spent years teaching technical subjects before moving into software in 2020. Each step sharpened how I solve problems and design for real people.
